caseName: Bishop v. United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware
caseNameFull: Romie David BISHOP, et ux. v. UNITED STATES BANKRUPTCY COURT FOR the DISTRICT OF DELAWARE

opinions.text: Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioners allowed until October 27, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
